transcoding_time.instruction: Estimate the recorded transcoding runtime on the source Intel i7-3720QM execution setup from input-video characteristics and the requested output encoding settings.
transcoding_time.field_description: duration: original video duration in seconds; codec/o_codec: input/requested output codec; width,height,o_width,o_height: input/output pixel dimensions; bitrate,o_bitrate: source-recorded input/output bitrate values, unscaled; framerate,o_framerate: frames per second; i,p,b: source counts of I/P/B frames; frames: total frames; i_size,p_size,b_size,size: source-recorded component and total byte sizes. The source experiment transcodes short segments; full original duration is metadata, not a claim of processing every original frame. Output memory consumption is excluded.
